COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

2. When learning Network Troubleshooting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Troubleshooting.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Troubleshooting.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Network Troubleshooting.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Network Troubleshooting.

3. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

5. When learning Cloud Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cloud Computing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Cloud Computing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cloud Computing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cloud Computing.

6. When learning Emerging Technologies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Technologies.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Technologies.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Technologies.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Technologies.

7. When learning Social and Ethical Issues in Networking, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Social and Ethical Issues in Networking.

8. When learning Career Opportunities, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities.

9. When learning Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Professional Ethics and Legal Issues in Computing.

10. When learning Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence Implications and Ethics.

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

12. When learning Artificial Intelligence Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence Concepts.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence Concepts.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence Concepts.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence Concepts.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Software Development Life Cycle and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Software Project Management and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Technologies and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Artificial Intelligence Concepts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
